data.name: Takedown
data.description: At 12th level, if you succeed on a drag maneuver, you can attempt a trip maneuver against the same target as a swift action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. At 15th level, you may do so after a successful grapple check. This ability replaces the 12th-level bonus feat.
